REQUIRED FOLLOW-ON, from m1, recorded here so it does not depend on anyone remembering.

Once the blend settles, ASSERT the narrowed precedent rather than documenting it: for every term in MayBeMissing, its imputed value times its default weight must be zero. One line over one set. It fails exactly on the case we are most tempted by -- Semantic, whose 0.5 at weight 1.0 would remove the largest contribution of all.

m1 proposed this and correctly declined to write it NOW: this P1 will restructure what 'imputed contribution' means, so a test written against today's meaning would be rewritten before it ever caught anything. Whoever closes this bead writes that test as part of closing it.

Related: bd-01M1789P5B9WVNCJFN3HXACWKN -- same defect class (absence converted into a plausible value) one layer down, in the discourse-position channel that feeds chronology.
